type.description:
### ⚠️ Requires [Provi's Origins](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki) to be installed! ⚠️

## Can See Any

---

[Bientity Condition Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Can-See-Any)

Checks whether the actor can see the target's eyes or feet.

Type ID: `proviorigins:can_see_any`

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
"bientity_condition": {
    "type": "proviorigins:can_see_any",
    "shape_type": "collider",
    "fluid_handling": "none"
}
```
Checks if the actor has a *traversable* view of the target.
